news.title: ECE's Bhave wins 2026 Wen Ko Technical Leadership Award
news.summary_en: Sunil Bhave, professor in Purdue University’s Elmore Family School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, has received the 2026 Wen Ko Technical Leadership Award from the Transducer Research Foundation.

news.title: From Pune to Purdue: Ananya Anand Nadkarni engineers smarter systems
news.summary_en: When Ananya Anand Nadkarni left Pune, Maharashtra, India, to study at Purdue University, she was looking for more than a degree.
